name: Orsen & Lowe Wholecut Derby
description: A single-piece upper derby in charcoal grey, cut from one panel of bonded synth-hide with no visible seams except at the heel. The silhouette is clean and slightly elongated. Orsen & Lowe is a mid-market brand that punches above its price — the kind of shoe that gets noticed by people who notice shoes.
functionality: Pressure-balanced cork footbed. No active tech.
what_it_says: You have an eye for quality and you don't need to explain it to anyone.
story_hooks: Orsen & Lowe recently lost their primary synth-hide supplier — authentic pairs are quietly becoming collectible.
A character wearing these in the Shelf immediately draws attention — they clearly don't belong.
